title: Repair serpentine flattening of ragged rows
goal: Implement serpentine_ragged(rows) for a list of lists of integers. Flatten the nonempty rows in their original row order: copy the first nonempty row left-to-right, the second right-to-left, the third left-to-right, and continue alternating. Empty rows contribute no values and do not advance this alternation. Preserve all occurrences of duplicate values. Empty outer input or all-empty rows returns []. Return a new list without modifying either the outer list or any inner row.
constraints: Only edit solution.py; do not add files or dependencies or modify tests.
Keep the public function name and one-argument signature unchanged.
Assume rows is a list of lists of integers.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct authored inputs covering the same stated specification
